body.message:
Hello Mr. Ahmad,

I hope you are doing well.

We have received the rate confirmation from the owner, and the total rate for a 12-month booking will be AED 120,000. The booking will be arranged for a total of 360 nights, with each month calculated as a 30-night stay.

Please note that there is also a refundable security deposit of AED 3,000, which will be returned upon check-out, provided there are no damages or outstanding charges in the apartment.

If you would like to proceed with the 12-month booking, you may either complete the full payment in advance or pay the first month, last month, and security deposit upfront to confirm the booking. The remaining balance can then be paid on a monthly basis.

Please let us know how you would like to proceed, and we will be happy to assist you further.

Thank you.
